# App notes (web-app owner)

## What changed (this pass)
- **server.py** (stdlib only, API contract kept): fixed `tail_timings` — timings live at
  `renders/draft/timings.jsonl` and `renders/history/<tag>/timings.jsonl`, not `renders/timings.jsonl`;
  now aggregates all of them (mtime-sorted). New endpoints `/api/timings` (all measured render times)
  and `/api/notes` (notes/*.md). Existing `/api/{status,plan,journal,renders}` unchanged.
- **index.html** full design pass: parchment/ink palette, Cormorant Garamond (Google Fonts CDN) +
  Georgia, numbered section rules, sticky nav board, no gradients.
- Lightbox (click any render to enlarge, Esc/backdrop closes), captions parsed from filenames
  (tag · camera role · preset · date).
- History grouped by snapshot tag, newest first, with dates.
- Stats: stat boxes (objects/meshes/faces/file sizes/time used+left) + measured render-timings table.
- Journal rendered as markdown (tiny JS parser: headings, paragraphs, lists, bold, code).
- Milestone/task board: colour-coded todo/doing/done/dropped + counts + "Now" box.
- Viewer: bbox-computed framing (target = scene centre, distance weighted to vertical extent so wide
  terrain doesn't push the camera out), min/max distance clamp, maxPolarAngle just under horizon,
  sky+fog background, hemisphere light, loading progress bar, "reload model" button for re-exports,
  note that the web glb is simplified vs the full scene.
- Footer credits: "Scene built procedurally in Blender 5.0 by an autonomous agent; after Pieter
  Bruegel the Elder (1563)".

## Verification (no vision — used app-screenshot + src/analyze.py ASCII maps)
- `app-screenshot` viewport + `--full`: "no console errors, failed requests or HTTP errors".
- ASCII map: left nav column present (dense ink blobs), viewer canvas ~48% sky-tone with varied
  texture (not empty/tiny), render grids populated with varied texture, timings table rows visible
  at higher-res crop, no giant blank areas (mean 203, std 46 on full page).
- All 6 API endpoints curl'd: valid JSON (status 7.6 KB, timings 57 entries, plan, journal,
  renders, notes).
- `app/start.sh` run twice: "app already running" both times, page still 200 — idempotent.

## Restart procedure (if server.py changes again)
`pkill -f 'app/server.py'` then start via a tracked background handle:
`cd /work && setsid nohup python3 app/server.py >> app/server.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &` —
note: launching it through a plain `subprocess.run` shell died with the parent; use the
kernel's `bash()` handle or `app/start.sh`.

## Limitations
- Viewer materials are the simplified glb export (plain colours, reduced instances) — stated on-page.
- History only has tags that exist under renders/history/; newest-first by file mtime.
- Journal parser is deliberately tiny: no tables/links/images in markdown.
- Page auto-refreshes stats every 20–60 s but the glb only reloads via the button.
